children: CASEYS GENERAL STORES INC reported quarterly results for 2026 with revenue of $5.68B and diluted EPS of $7.37, both up materially versus the year-ago quarter as retail fuel and in-store sales strengthened.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Revenue growth of 24.3% was driven by a 36.3% increase in retail fuel and stronger in-store sales despite a 0.3% decline in same-store gallons.
Fuel profitability benefited from higher fuel margin per gallon and RIN activity.
Prepared food same-store sales rose 4.8% led by pizza, while grocery and merchandise same-store sales increased 2.7%, aided by non‑alcoholic beverages.
Store footprint expanded by a net 15 locations in the quarter to 2,959 stores; 71% are in towns with populations under 20,000 and 240 stores have car washes.
EV and distribution investments include 294 EV chargers at 68 stores across 14 states, three distribution centers, and a self‑distributing fuel terminal.
